Hi all,

I'm sharing the following on behalf of my current employer. I joined Kry10 in August and I'm finding them enjoyable to work for - if you have substantial ITP experience please give this role consideration, and feel free to share it on to others in your networks!

Best,

Wrenna Robson (Senior Verification Researcher @ Kry10)

Kry10 UK is hiring a Senior Verification Researcher. The role’s focus is to lead the formal verification of VM ephemerality for a cross-domain ("browse-down") security appliance, as part of an *ARIA Safeguarded AI* project delivered jointly with PentenAmio and Galois.*

The role: produce machine-checked arguments that no information persists between sessions of an untrusted VM, running on seL4. When a session ends, the VM is torn down and its capabilities revoked; each new session is built to a known-good state from an immutable, cryptographically signed image, so that compromise of the untrusted side is provably non-persistent. You'll specify and verify these properties on top of the formally verified seL4 microkernel, building on its behavioural model and existing proof base, working in e.g., Rocq and Iris alongside our formal verification researchers in the UK and Australia. You're not expected to build the system, as we have engineers leading that; your role is to work with them prove useful security properties about it. Building a formal model and proving properties of it is a legitimate outcome even where not fully connected to the implementation / code.*

Key details:
- Permanent, full time; UK remote or hybrid (Gloucester office; relocation available)
- £100k + pension + ESOP, with some flexibility for exceptional candidates
- Substantial ITP experience required (Rocq, Isabelle/HOL, or Lean); Kry10 mainly uses Rocq + Iris, so willingness to work in Rocq is key
- Experience with systems-level verification (OS, hypervisors, memory management)
- Familiarity with the seL4 ecosystem and its proofs is very useful but not a prerequisite
- Exceptional early-career researchers (e.g. finishing a PhD) are warmly encouraged; seniority can flex to the candidate
- AI-assisted verification is a core part of the project's research agenda
- Start date: ASAP; we will close the role once filled.

*The full advert can be found here*.

To apply, please send a CV and short covering letter (details in full advert) to recruitment@kry10.com with the subject line "UK Senior Verification Researcher - [Your Name]". Questions welcome at the same address.
